subject: C3 52d17357 review: no hard blockers
body:
Review of 52d17357 (C3), read-only, stability/hardware only. NO hard blockers found.
(1) Inert encoder: ended=1 makes every setter/bytes/texture/sampler/pipeline method TEGU_INVALID-and-return before touching target; setLabel/setViewport/setScissorRect/all 5 draw variants/endEncoding/setDepthStencilState have explicit inert returns; instanced and indexed draws forward to guarded ones; indirect draws only invalidate. teguExecute: error=invalid||encoding => zero jobs submitted; endEncoding clears encoding so completion fires with error. dealloc skips INVALID, releases nil target safely. Residual nil returns remain: renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor with nil descriptor, already-committed command, or a previous encoder still not ended (render_encoder.inc ~3357), and OOM in the inert allocation. RenderBox would crash only if it opens a pass before endEncoding of the prior one.
(2) Depth/stencil: checked at draw time in all non-indirect draws; default state (Always, no write, no stencil) accepted only because aux store is DontCare+no resolve; any depth write, non-Always compare, or any stencil face refuses via TEGU_INVALID, not silently. Fragment-shader depth output is not tracked (edge).
(3) Retry: 250x20ms, usleep outside n2mb lock, first-attempt success identical to before. Note: a permanently power-failed GPU stalls first Metal use in every process by ~5 s.
(4) Gate runs after super init, before protocols/dlopen/IOKit/open; fail-safe if access() denied.
(5) newPipelineLibraryWithFilePath nil+NSError matches CA path (logs, continues; no abort).
